title: Claude Code Tutorial for Beginners: From Install to First Autonomous Task
summary: Install Claude Code, write your first CLAUDE.md, run plan mode, and ship a real feature — all in under 30 minutes. Beginner tutorial, nothing skipped.
body_markdown: GitHub Copilot works inline inside your editor, completing code as you type. Claude Code runs in your terminal and executes full autonomous tasks — write a feature, run tests, fix failures, open a PR — without you writing code line-by-line. Claude Code grew from 3% to 18% work adoption in eight months and reached an NPS of 54, the highest in any AI coding tool category. See the[full comparison](https://blink.new/blog/claude-code-vs-github-copilot) for a side-by-side breakdown.
